title: Hancock: the Great Pyramid was not a tomb but a portal

tellings.quote: So when I speak to Graham Hancock, he says, you know, I don't think that a lot of this ancient architecture, you know, for example, he says that the the pyramid was not a tomb
I I asked Graham Hancock point blank, what do you think their actual function was if they weren't a tomb? And he almost implied that they were like a a Stargate.
tellings.difference: Adds the Orion's belt alignment and the word 'stargate', and also credits Dunn, Schoch and the Book of Enoch.
tellings.link_reason: Both relay Graham Hancock's view that the Great Pyramid was not a tomb but a portal or stargate.

as_told.title: Giza pyramids aligned with Orion's belt as a stargate

tellings.quote: is you talk to you know Graham Hancock and he says that he says adamantly he's like the pyramids were not just a tomb they were you know something else and you know maybe like some sort of like celestial ascent chamber portal thing.
tellings.difference: Calls it a 'celestial ascent chamber' where the story's tellings say Stargate or portal, and speaks of the pyramids in the plural.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings carry Hancock's claim, relayed by Jesse Michels, that the pyramid was not a tomb but a portal-like device.

as_told.title: Graham Hancock: the pyramids were not just tombs but a celestial ascent chamber

related.note: Both are about the true purpose of the Great Pyramid. Dunn says it was a power plant and Hancock says it was a portal rather than a tomb, so the two claims compete.

plain: The pyramids of Giza were not tombs but something like a portal or 'stargate', a kind of chamber for rising up to the heavens, according to what the author Graham Hancock told Michels. Michels passes this on across several episodes, saying that when he asked Hancock point blank what they were for, Hancock almost implied a stargate, and in one telling he ties it to the pyramids' alignment with the stars of Orion's belt and to the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text, in the translation by R. H. Charles published in 1917. If true, the pyramids would have been built as a doorway to the sky rather than a burial place.
